description: The Railway System Data Inventory (RSDI) of the European Union Agency for Railways is a repository of standard input data for economic analyses of the EU railway sector, especially cost-benefit analyses and economic impact assessments. It gives indicative unit costs and reference values or ranges for the dimensions of railway assets, products and operations, so that analysts can choose assumptions of the right order of magnitude. The values were consolidated from published literature and feedback from rail companies, mostly anonymous surveys, by a task force of the ERA Economic Steering Group in 2024, and the group updates them annually with experts from the ERA representative bodies. Coverage is continental (the EU railway system). The inventory is published on the ERA website free of charge; reproduction is permitted with credit to the Agency and the disclaimer that the value is indicative. Caveats: the values are indicative only, are not statistics or official averages, have reference years from 2021 to 2024, and their robustness and representativeness cannot be measured. They support cost-benefit and investment appraisal of rail infrastructure projects and give parameter ranges for capacity and resilience models. They complement the Rail Market Monitoring Scheme and are related to the Register of Infrastructure (RINF).
